global.statement: Keep descriptions only for meaningful consequences, validation, permissions, uncertainty or a necessary next step. No repeated statuses or filler paragraphs.
Preserve current pink primary, blue supporting and restrained surfaces. No purple/violet. Color changes require human judgment.
Intrinsic responsive layout; comfortable targets; check mobile, desktop, large desktop, short height and enlarged text. Do not copy screenshot coordinates.
Closing pending presentation does not cancel dispatch. Preserve progress, prevent duplicate writes and reconcile unknown outcomes.
Local changes cannot repaint shared owners. Shared changes must propagate; check protected surroundings. Never widen scope just to pass.

rules: Use semantic roles. Functional supporting actions need visible boundaries. Quiet content text stays transparent on hover; safe alternatives remain visible above critical confirmation on mobile.
Job lifecycle owns label, icon and paint. Separate operation outcomes and attachment tags. Equivalent status/theme/size/state instances must share component-owned styling.
Place lifecycle at upper right relative to heading. Preserve wrapping and separation without fixed page coordinates.
Safe alternative has a visible boundary; critical confirmation is last on mobile. No competing filled dismissal.
Content modal dims/blurs backdrop, has bounded responsive width and usable overflow. Escape/X remain available during pending work. Navigation menus do not use this backdrop.
One borderless close control with accessible name and comfortable target. No filled rectangle hover.
Shared top-left back pattern: readable responsive size, transparent hover, keyboard focus, no raised action treatment.
Omit unavailable directions entirely. Borderless at rest; enabled icons show a soft tonal circle/fine inset edge on hover without geometry shift.
Comfortable arrow inset, rounded shadowed panel, faint item separators and keyboard navigation.
One coherent message/action grouping. Keep actions outside painted live region. Use semantic restrained tones and consistent icon/text alignment.
Sticky header, stable page bounds, bottom clearance and short-height fallback. Global shell changes require full checks.
Separate neutral attachment tag, readable blue destination and timestamp. No Newest first or saving-does-not-complete reminder.
Long multilingual comments disclose. Public cards show job reference text without inaccessible private navigation. No verification explainer.

exceptions.reason: Compact navigation icons need a bounded tonal circle; quiet content text still stays transparent.
